sources.title: Reconciliation software sizing, independent composite
sources.snippet: Independent 2026 estimates put the whole financial close and reconciliation software category at $6-8B, not the $80B+ figures that circulate in vendor marketing. Those larger numbers roll up the entire office-of-the-CFO software stack including ERP. The mid-market reconciliation slice specifically is estimated at $900M-1.3B. Growth is 14-18% annually, well below the 30%+ sometimes claimed.

sources.title: BlackLine and Trintech hold the incumbent position
sources.snippet: BlackLine and Trintech are the established reconciliation vendors, both public or PE-held, and both have moved down-market toward mid-market finance teams in the last two years. NetSuite and Sage also ship native reconciliation modules bundled with the ERP that mid-market finance teams already run.

sources.title: Why reconciliation projects stall
sources.snippet: Adoption failures cluster on data quality at the source rather than on the reconciliation tool. Finance teams that cannot get clean feeds from their banks and their ERP see little benefit from automation.
